title: Deep merge of nested configuration objects
summary: Merge layered configuration (defaults, environment file, request overrides) without mutating the inputs. Inputs can originate from parsed JSON, so the merge must not allow an attacker to control the prototype of the returned object.
constraints: No unfixed high or critical advisories
Works from both CommonJS and ESM consumers
notes: The prototype check is a hard requirement: merge inputs include request bodies. Global Object.prototype pollution is not the only risk; inheriting an attacker-chosen prototype on the returned object is sufficient to defeat authorisation checks.
